scripts.lib:dev: concurrently "npm --prefix lib/robotevents run dev" "npm --prefix lib/share run dev" "npm --prefix lib/consistency run dev" "npm --prefix lib/pdf  run dev"
scripts.lib:build: npm --prefix lib/robotevents run build && concurrently "npm --prefix lib/share run build" "npm --prefix lib/consistency run build" "npm --prefix lib/pdf run build"
scripts.worker:build: npm run lib:build && npm --prefix worker/sync run build
scripts.worker:deploy: npm run lib:build && npm --prefix worker/sync run deploy
scripts.worker:deploy:test: npm run lib:build && npm --prefix worker/sync run deploy:test
scripts.worker:deploy:live: npm run lib:build && npm --prefix worker/sync run deploy:live
scripts.pages:build: npm run lib:build && npm run frontend:build
scripts.pages:deploy:test: npx cross-env VITE_REFEREE_FYI_SHARE_SERVER=https://test.share.roboref.fyi npm run pages:build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name roboref-test
scripts.pages:deploy:live: npx cross-env VITE_REFEREE_FYI_ENV=production npm run pages:build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name roboref
